purpose: Monitor Taiwan listed and OTC equities through the existing governed HENGCE EOD vessel using paid FinMind data. For HENGCE Market State, 'all Taiwan equities' is explicitly defined as current TWSE plus TPEx ordinary equities. Emerging-board equities are out of scope.

data_vessel.membership_rule: take latest date row per stock_id; keep current twse/tpex four-digit equities; exclude emerging, ETF, ETN, TDR-like and other non-common-equity rows

scope_semantics.all_taiwan_equities: current TWSE plus TPEx ordinary equities only; emerging-board equities are excluded by policy
scope_semantics.hengce_electronics100_diagnostic: legacy operating-universe diagnostic only; no longer represents the whole market

coverage_gate.rule: Fail closed if either TWSE or TPEx snapshot presence falls below 98%. Emerging equities are not part of the monitored universe.

allowed_persisted_derived_context: membership metadata and TWSE/TPEx market counts
cross-sectional change-rate mean/median/quantiles in vendor units
cross-sectional median absolute change rate in vendor units
aggregate turnover and top-10 turnover share
explicitly_not_authorized: including emerging-board equities in the Market State universe
persisting raw or per-ticker FinMind snapshot rows in this Market State auxiliary
using Electronics100 as the primary whole-market observation scope
changing frozen S5 Market State features
creating or selecting a new state label
